observations.body: During the meal Jesus blesses, breaks, and gives bread as his body; gives a cup as covenant blood poured for forgiveness; looks toward future drinking; sings and departs.
observations.label: Bread and cup are given before hymn and departure

observations.body: The passage presents Blessing, breaking, giving, drinking, singing, and leaving as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Blessing, breaking, giving, drinking, singing, and leaving

observations.body: The passage places Future drinking in the Father’s kingdom beside Blessing, breaking, giving, drinking, singing, and leaving.
observations.label: Future drinking in the Father’s kingdom

payload.posture: Read Matthew 26:26–30 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states during the meal Jesus blesses, breaks, and gives bread as his body; gives a cup as covenant blood poured for forgiveness; looks toward future drinking; sings and departs. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
payload.title: Bread and cup are given before hymn and departure
